title: Review planner
subject: Arabic
unit: Spring 2: Local area, holiday and travel: travel and holidays (2.2, 2.1)
source: Written for arabic/y10 lesson 42 (Pupil PDF worksheet: review planner)
intro: Lesson 42: Writing reviews of accommodation. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

arabic.text:
نَزَلْتُ فِي هٰذَا الفُنْدُقِ فِي شَهْرِ إِبْرِيل.
الغُرْفَةُ كَانَتْ نَظِيفَةً وَالمُوَظَّفُونَ لُطَفَاءُ جِدًّا.
لٰكِنَّ الإِنْتَرْنِتَ كَانَ بَطِيئًا.
التَّقْيِيمُ: أَرْبَعُ نُجُومٍ.
أَنْصَحُ بِهِ لِلْعَائِلَاتِ لِأَنَّهُ قَرِيبٌ مِنَ المَسْجِدِ.

parts.label: Teacher
parts.text: أَنْصَحُ بِـ + the hotel + لِأَنَّهُ + reason.

questions.q: Write a recommendation sentence for a hotel near the beach.
questions.a: أَنْصَحُ بِهٰذَا الفُنْدُقِ لِأَنَّهُ قَرِيبٌ مِنَ البَحْرِ

questions.q: Write a 90-word review (our own exam-style task) in the portal response box following the structure, with past tense, كَانَ + adjective and a recommendation.
questions.a: Balanced review with all five parts and accurate agreement

questions.q: Extend: Group A (4AA1): write a three-sentence summary of your answer in other words and give the i'rab of one sentence. Group B (1AA0): say your answer aloud in a breakout and answer one follow-up question.
questions.a: Group A: accurate summary and i'rab; Group B: fluent spoken answer
A) The internet was slow. لٰكِنَّ الإِنْتَرْنِتَ كَانَ بَطِيئًا.

questions.q: Think again: how should a Muslim write a review?
questions.a: Honest and fair, kind in wording.
